articles.title: Backyard Astronomer Films Colossal 'Godzilla' Plasma Cloud on the Sun
articles.summary: Using a specialized telescope, Mark Johnston captured a towering solar prominence shaped like Godzilla. The structure is plasma suspended by magnetic fields, not fire, and shows coronal rain falling along invisible field lines.

articles.title: A Spectacular Planet Parade: Venus, Jupiter, and Mercury Align in June's Evening Sky
articles.summary: Throughout June, Venus, Jupiter, and Mercury will be visible together in the western sky. The highlight is June 9, when Venus and Jupiter appear just 1.6 degrees apart—a stunning conjunction.

articles.title: Behind the Scenes at the Smithsonian: 150 Million Objects You've Never Seen
articles.summary: The Smithsonian's Museum Support Center houses a vast collection of specimens, from meteorites to preserved worms. Only a fraction is on display; the rest fuels scientific research, like linking DDT to eagle declines.
